A wire EDM cutting operation is performed on a shaped part conveyed on a conveyor belt using a molybdenum wire with a cutting speed of 10 mm/min, peak current of 15A, and pulse duration of 50ns, for 84 minutes, to produce a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

The laser cutting operation is performed on the Laser Cutter for 2 minutes using a laser power of 1.5 kW, a cutting speed of 200 mm/s, and nitrogen gas assist, transforming the input sheet metal on the conveyor belt into a cut sheet metal piece that remains on the conveyor belt.

Shearing is performed on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 29 minutes to cut sheet metal into sheared sheet metal, using a high-carbon steel blade at a shear angle of 45 degrees and a cutting speed of 120 mm/s, with the input sheet metal on the conveyor belt becoming the output sheared sheet metal also on the conveyor belt.

A Vertical Lathe Turning operation is performed for 31 minutes on a Metal bar input component using a Carbide tool at a rotation speed of 500 RPM and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, resulting in a Lathed part output component on the ConveyorBelt.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 27 minutes at a spindle speed of 1000 RPM, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and a drill size of 8 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent that is then conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 96 minutes using a contour milling path at a milling speed of 1800 RPM to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 μm, starting with a milled part on a conveyor belt and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a mobile robot.
